# WetCanvas

> WetCanvas is a global online community platform for visual artists featuring forums, member directories, art challenges, and reference libraries.

WetCanvas serves as a vibrant hub for artists to connect, share work, participate in monthly challenges across multiple mediums (watercolor, acrylic, wildlife art), and access curated reference materials. The platform is transitioning to ArtistNetwork while maintaining its core community features and monthly competitive events.

## Core Platform

- [Home - WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists](https://www.wetcanvas.com): WetCanvas homepage connecting visual artists worldwide in community forum.
- [Forums - WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists](https://www.wetcanvas.com/forums-index): Main forums index organizing discussion areas for artist community.
- [About Wet Canvas - WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists](https://www.wetcanvas.com/info-center): About page explaining WetCanvas features and site navigation.
- [Members – WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists](https://www.wetcanvas.com/members): Members directory enabling artist network discovery and profiles.

- [March 2026 Challenges - WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists](https://www.wetcanvas.com/forums/topic/march-2026-challenges): Monthly art challenges announcement for watercolor, acrylic, wildlife.
